researchNote: Award list sourced from Wikipedia's compiled 'List of decorations awarded by the United States National Guard' (Washington section), which itself cites an official publication: 'The Washington National Guard State Awards and Decorations Program' (Washington National Guard, Camp Murray, WA, 1 April 2018). That primary document was not directly fetchable in this research pass. 9 of 15 individual awards were independently cross-checked against live USAMM.com product listings. Entries without a USAMM cross-check are flagged needs-source. No inStatePrecedence order was stated in the source, so precedence is null throughout.
